resources.string: Authorization is stored on this device. If the sign-in service is temporarily unavailable, Ferventio can continue working directly with Twitch while the current Twitch session remains valid. Signing out does not remove local channels, history, drafts, or preferences.
Removes server sessions, pending OAuth state, and push data for this installation. Other devices are not affected.
Signs out every Ferventio device for this Twitch account and removes server-side push access. Local data remains on each device.
This installation will lose its server authorization and push access. Local channels, history, drafts, and preferences remain on the device.
Every Ferventio device for this Twitch account will lose server authorization and push access. Each device will need to sign in again. Local data is not deleted.
